about: The Cozy Sleeping Bag quest chain on WoW: Forever, for Guides/SleepingBag.lua and the smoke test. Quest ids, titles, levels and the objects' spots are from Wowhead's Forever database (2026-10-15); the collected data hasn't seen these quests yet. Every quest starts and ends at an object you click, needs level 14 and can't be shared. Spots are 0..1 on the uiMapID. Each faction's steps, in order: the guide's quest steps must be exactly these.

80001.title: Rekindle
80001.note: The camp's firepit (Stonetalon 40.6, 52.4). Optional, and some can't click the fire: named in a note, never a step.
